title: Why AI-Driven Email Security Needs More Than One AI Model
content_md: Modern email phishing rarely has one obvious warning sign. AI-driven email security therefore needs to be a layered AI architecture that interprets content, context, behavior, visuals, destinations, and threat intelligence together - ideally before the message reaches the inbox. Article Link: AI-Driven Email Security: A Guide To Layered Protection
